words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the final ayah begin with relation rather than with new lexical content. It can be heard as coordination with the preceding motive chain or as a resumptive close, but in either case the promised satisfaction is not detached from 92:18-20. The opening particle also yields its oath-like force to {{ar:لَسَوْفَ}} ({{tr:la-sawfa}}), so the boundary is connective while the guarantee is carried by the following emphatic future. In sound and writing, the connector is fused into the front-loaded particle cluster, making the close move straight from linkage into assurance. That linkage lets the final promise answer the earlier easing promise (92:7) and rest on divine ownership of the first and last life (92:13).

words.prose: {{ar:لَسَوْفَ}} ({{tr:la-sawfa}}) is the ayah's guarantee-engine. The lām supplies assertion, while the future particle stretches the promise beyond an immediate result; together they govern {{ar:يَرْضَىٰ}} ({{tr:yarḍā}}) as an emphatic future outcome rather than a bare prediction. Because no conditional particle opens the clause, the prior motive chain is treated as the established ground for a promised result, not as a hypothetical still waiting to be tested. The construction is also rhetorically marked: the same emphatic future shape can intensify warning in the knowing refrain (102:3-4), but here it is redirected toward satisfaction. Together with the opening connector, it helps place three function morphemes before the one content verb; its own two pre-verbal units delay the compact final verb, so the recitation builds anticipation before contentment lands.

topics.headline: certain future governs the verb

topics.reason: QAC and translation-support evidence identify the word as emphatic lām plus future particle, preserving both assertion and futurity over the following verb.

topics.headline: promise is not framed as hypothetical

topics.reason: The local clause contains the connective, emphatic future particle, and verb, but no conditional particle governing the promise.

topics.headline: marked construction redirects warning force to promise

topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give the same construction in the knowing warning (102:3-4), while the local object of the promise is satisfaction.

topics.reason: Three function morphemes precede the single lexical verb, making the local word order itself a front-loaded promissory pathway.

words.prose: {{ar:يَرْضَىٰ}} ({{tr:yarḍā}}) is the whole lexical landing of the surah. Under {{ar:لَسَوْفَ}} ({{tr:la-sawfa}}), the imperfect verb becomes a promised future state, not a present description or a completed past. Its subject is not named in the ayah; the 3ms morphology sends the reader back through the passage to the righteous giver in 92:17, the one who gave and sought the divine face. The verb has no object here, so the satisfaction is left whole rather than narrowed to a specified reward, sacrifice, or object of approval. The root field keeps satisfaction, pleasure, approval, and acceptance together, while local grammar selects the subject's intransitive state. Variant and form contrasts sharpen that agency: the active Form I surface centers the subject becoming pleased, while passive or causative alternatives would make satisfaction something explicitly effected upon another. As the closing seal, the word converts the outward motive of 92:20 into inward contentment, answers the easing promise (92:7), rests on divine ownership of both lives (92:13), stands against the blazing-fire outcome (92:14), and ends on an open long vowel that links to the preceding close while letting the promised state resonate.

topics.headline: objectless satisfaction remains whole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promised satisfaction is not limited to a named object, reward, or transaction.
topics.reason: The local verb instance has no object and is marked intransitive here, even though contextual profiles show the root can occur with objects elsewhere.

topics.headline: implicit subject points back to the righteous giver
topics.reader_payoff: The reader must recover the final subject from the earlier masculine singular participant, which makes the close read backward through the whole positive portrait.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses the unexpressed 3ms subject as the ongoing masculine singular participant from 92:17; the possible divine-subject pressure survives only as semantic nearness between human satisfaction and divine approval.

topics.headline: imperfect becomes promised futurity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the verb as an assured future arrival of satisfaction rather than a current mood or a fixed adjective.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an imperfect verb, and the preceding emphatic future particle shifts the verb into the promised future frame.

topics.headline: active Form I centers the subject's state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the canonical surface predicates satisfaction from the subject's side, while variant and causative contrasts show what the wording did not choose.
topics.reason: The local surface is active Form I intransitive; passive and causative alternatives are useful contrastive apparatus but do not replace the canonical agency.

topics.headline: root field joins contentment and approval
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the final state as more than a thin emotion: it includes settled acceptance and approval.
topics.reason: V4 branch evidence supports satisfaction, acceptance, and being pleased as the relevant root field, while local grammar keeps the selected sense intransitive.

topics.headline: seeking resolves into contentment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the active pursuit of 92:20 become the received inward state of 92:21.
topics.reason: The same recovered subject crosses from the motive clause in 92:20 into the emphatic future main clause in 92:21, so the boundary itself marks the role shift.

topics.headline: single verb seals the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word carries subject recovery, object omission, and promised resolution in one compact verb.
topics.reason: The final ayah contains one lexical verb with an implicit subject and no object, making the closure unusually compressed.

topics.headline: final satisfaction resolves earlier surah movements
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final satisfaction as the positive endpoint of earlier promise, ownership, deed, and warning movements.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows name concrete links to the easing promise (92:7), divine ownership (92:13), the blazing-fire contrast (92:14), deed linkage in 92:18-20, and satisfaction scenes (98:8; 89:28).

topics.headline: open long-vowel ending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the surah end on an open sustained vowel that matches the unfixed scope of the promised satisfaction.
topics.reason: The terminal written and recited ending supports the phonetic observation, while the claim remains secondary to the verb's grammar and semantics.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **Future satisfaction as accepted outcome.** Evidence: `ر ض و` B001 (acceptance opposed to displeasure), B002 (sought/abundant approval). Structural cue: the future particle follows purified seeking of the Lord’s face. Mechanism: the sought face answers with satisfaction, whether God’s approval, the giver’s contentment, or both are activated. Abductive move: I preserve both directions because the root allows approval as state and sought approval as object. Reading change: the ending is relational acceptance, not merely payment.

2. **Mutual consent after non-transactional giving.** Evidence: `ر ض و` B003 (mutual consent), activated by 92:19 no favor repaid and 92:20 face-seeking. Structural cue: after all human debts are excluded, a two-sided رضى remains. Mechanism: the purified giver and Lord meet in consent rather than exchange. Abductive move: I infer reciprocity without commerce. Reading change: the final promise is communion-like satisfaction, not wage-settlement.

3. **Appeasement after warning.** Evidence: `ر ض و` B004 (making another satisfied/appeasing), activated by 92:14 warning and 92:17 avoidance of fire. Structural cue: terror is not the last word; رضى closes the sequence. Mechanism: the path from warning through giving removes displeasure. Abductive move: I infer that the warning’s purpose is to make this satisfaction possible. Reading change: the surah ends with resolved pleasure after alarm, not with fear alone.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: 92:20’s “Highest” retrospectively turned this fall into a vertical contrast: wealth pulls downward while the sought face belongs above. 92:19 also clarified that the failed مال is not just insufficient currency but a bad substitute in an economy where only God-facing giving works.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Satisfaction as the delayed endpoint of the giving course.** `يَرْضَىٰ` directly anchors `ر ض و:B001` (acceptance and satisfaction opposed to displeasure), and `لَسَوْفَ` makes that state prospective. The carried-forward agent gives and purifies himself in 92:18, has no human repayment claim in 92:19, and seeks a single direction in 92:20. The packet supplies the sequence; the inferred arrow is that purified, directed giving terminates in acceptance rather than depletion. Satisfaction consequently reads as the course’s eventual state, not a disconnected promise of pleasant feeling.

2. **The satisfaction sought and the satisfaction attained remain coactive.** `ر ض و:B002` names abundant or specially sought approval, and the immediately preceding `ٱبْتِغَآءَ` activates its “sought” scope even though the fixed active verb primarily carries `ر ض و:B001`. The abductive move is to let the sought object in 92:20 specify the relational field of the later satisfaction without changing the verb’s morphology. The ayah can therefore hold both the agent’s becoming satisfied and an orientation toward approval, rather than forcing one to erase the other.

3. **Exploratory convergence rather than a one-way transaction.** `ر ض و:B003` supplies mutual consent, while `ر ض و:B004` preserves the causative possibility of making another satisfied. Seeking a face in 92:20 followed by unexpressed-subject `يَرْضَىٰ` leaves relational direction less explicit than the preceding material gift. The packet gives branch possibilities and sequence, but mutual convergence is an abductive extension, not a grammatical certainty. This final reading keeps satisfaction relational and potentially reciprocal while refusing to decide which party’s approval exhausts the ayah.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah exists in the packet. Rereading the preceding portion of the clipped window added no later activation; `ر ض و:B002`, `ر ض و:B003`, and `ر ض و:B004` therefore remain explicitly relational and exploratory beside the primary satisfaction branch `ر ض و:B001`.

findings.text: Gelecekteki hoşnutluk, arınmış ve tek yöne çevrilmiş vermenin eksilmeyle değil kabul ve doyumla sonuçlanan gecikmiş varış noktasıdır.
Önceki arayış, kişinin hoşnut olmasıyla aranan hoşnutluğun aynı ilişkisel alanda birlikte etkin kalmasına imkân verir.
Karşılıksız vermenin ardından hoşnutluk, ticari olmayan karşılıklı bir kabul veya birini hoşnut etme yakınlaşması olarak okunabilir; öznenin yönü bunu kesinleştirmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak tanıklığı aynı sıfat biçimine buyruğa uyan, seven ve bir yükümlülüğe güvence veren kişi anlamlarını yükler. Geçici çerçeve ancak bunlar tek bir birleşik kişilik niteliği değil, bağlama göre seçilen üç ayrı okuma olarak tutulursa geçerlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üç anlam birbirine karıştırılmaz: buyruğa uyma davranışı, sevgi yönelimi ve güvence üstlenme ayrı bağlamsal seçeneklerdir; beğenilmiş olma anlamı bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıf yalındır; sıfat, herhangi bir ek söz kalıbına bağlı olmadan üç ayrı anlamdan birini taşır, fakat bu anlamlar ortak bir çekirdekte birleştirilemez.

concept_map.definition: Tek bir sıfat biçiminin bağlama göre buyruğa uyan, seven veya bir yükümlülüğe güvence veren kişiyi göstermesidir. Bu üç okuma seçeneklidir ve aynı kullanımda birlikte varsayılmaz.

facets.statement: Aynı sıfat biçiminin ortak bir anlamda birleşmeyen üç seçenekli okumaya sahip olması.

Bir kimseyi veya şeyi seven kişi.
Bir yükümlülük için güvence veren veya sorumluluğu üstlenen kişi.
